_comment: Copy to config.json on the Pi Zero edge node (git-ignored). NO secrets live in this file — the sensitive material (edge cert/key, edgeIndexKey, audit key) is referenced by PATH and provisioned separately (vps/pki/door-ca.sh issue-edge + edge.provision_audit_key). This is the WiFi/broker model (door-controller-wifi.md): the edge dials the on-site broker over mTLS; the old Pico-UART relay model is retired.

broker._note: the on-site broker VIP the edge dials over mTLS (Link A). host is also the TLS server_hostname, so the broker's IP-SAN cert verifies against the internal CA.

paths._note: cert/key/ca/edge_index_key come from `door-ca.sh issue-edge`; verify_key is the PUBLIC DOOR_ALLOWLIST_VERIFY_KEY (base64 SPKI); audit_key from `edge.provision_audit_key`. edge.key + edge.index.key + audit_key are 0600. envelope_store/audit_log/clock_floor are runtime state (writable).
paths._import_envelopes_note: optional: a drop dir of signed per-door envelopes to seed the rung-3 cache at boot (each is signature+anti-rollback verified on import). Omit in normal operation (the broker pushes envelopes).

verify_key_b64_note: alternative to paths.verify_key: paste the base64 SPKI DOOR_ALLOWLIST_VERIFY_KEY inline here as "verify_key_b64": "..."

rtc._note: clock-trust policy for the F4 fail-secure gate (offline decisions LOCK on an untrusted clock). auto=trust if NTP-synced OR a hardware RTC node is present; systemd=NTP only; hwrtc=RTC node only; never=always untrusted (safest); assume=always trusted (BENCH/DEV ONLY).

nfc._mock_note: set driver to 'mock' and add "codes": ["AABBCCDD"] to test without hardware

relay._note: the door strike on the edge (fail-secure: de-energized at rest, pulses only on a grant). active_high maps energize→physical level; some relay boards/strikes are active-low.
relay._console_note: set driver to 'console' (bench) or 'mock' (tests) to run without GPIO

ui._console_note: set driver to 'console' for headless bring-up
